Component.description: Category of metadata (e.g. Tools, Publications, etc.); provide the same one for all items/rows.
Component.title: Component

Filename.description: The path of a file in Synapse, relative to the project. The file associated with the path will be annotated with attributes contained in this sheet.
Filename.title: Filename

NGSLibraryLayout.description: Text description of the library layout, one of Paired-end or Single.
NGSLibraryLayout.title: NGS Library Layout

NGSLibraryPreparationDaysfromIndex.description: Number of days between sample for assay was received in lab and the libraries were prepared for sequencing [number]. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'
NGSLibraryPreparationDaysfromIndex.title: NGS Library Preparation Days from Index

NGSLibraryPreparationKitName.description: Name of Library Preparation Kit. String
NGSLibraryPreparationKitName.title: NGS Library Preparation Kit Name

NGSLibraryPreparationKitVendor.description: Vendor of Library Preparation Kit. String
NGSLibraryPreparationKitVendor.title: NGS Library Preparation Kit Vendor

NGSLibraryPreparationKitVersion.description: Version of Library Preparation Kit. String
NGSLibraryPreparationKitVersion.title: NGS Library Preparation Kit Version

NGSLibrarySelectionMethod.description: How nucleic acid molecules are isolated.
NGSLibrarySelectionMethod.title: NGS Library Selection Method

NGSLibrarySourceMaterial.description: The type of source material being sequenced.
NGSLibrarySourceMaterial.title: NGS Library Source Material

NGSLibrarySourceMolecule.description: The source of nucleic acids represented in the sequencing library.
NGSLibrarySourceMolecule.title: NGS Library Source Molecule

NGSLibraryStrategy.description: The assay associated with the nucleic acid library (e.g., RNA-Seq, ChIP-Seq)
NGSLibraryStrategy.title: NGS Library Strategy

NGSRNADV200.description: Represents the percentage of RNA fragments that are >200 nucleotides in size. Number
NGSRNADV200.title: NGS RNA DV200

NGSRNAEndBias.description: The end of the cDNA molecule that is preferentially sequenced, e.g. 3/5 prime tag/end or the full length transcript
NGSRNAEndBias.title: NGS RNA End Bias

NGSRNARIN.description: A numerical assessment of the integrity of RNA based on the entire electrophoretic trace of the RNA sample including the presence or absence of degradation products. Number
NGSRNARIN.title: NGS RNA RIN

NGSRNAReverseTranscriptionPrimer.description: An oligo to which new deoxyribonucleotides can be added by DNA polymerase [SO_0000112]. The type of primer used for reverse transcription, e.g. oligo-dT or random primer. This allows users to identify content of the cDNA library input e.g. enriched for mRNA
NGSRNAReverseTranscriptionPrimer.title: NGS RNA Reverse Transcription Primer

NGSRawReads.description: Reads not yet analyzed in any way to be used for data analysis. The number of reads that pass filter from the flow cell represented in the FASTQ file.
NGSRawReads.title: NGS Raw Reads

NGSReadIndicator.description: Indicate if this is Read 1 (R1), Read 2 (R2), Index Reads (I1), or Other
NGSReadIndicator.title: NGS Read Indicator

NGSReadLength.description: The average length of the sequencing reads. Can be integer, null
NGSReadLength.title: NGS Read Length

NGSSequencingCoverage.description: Depth of coverage on assembly used. Found by (Unique Aligned Basecalls)/(Reference Length)
NGSSequencingCoverage.title: NGS Sequencing Coverage

NGSSequencingDesignDescription.description: Free-form description of the methods used to create the sequencing library; a brief 'materials and methods' section.
NGSSequencingDesignDescription.title: NGS Sequencing Design Description

NGSSequencingLibraryConstructionDaysfrom.description: Number of days between sample for assay was received in lab and day of sequencing library construction [number]. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'
NGSSequencingLibraryConstructionDaysfrom.title: NGS Sequencing Library Construction Days from Index

NGSSequencingPlatform.description: A platform is an object aggregate that is the set of instruments and software needed to perform a process [OBI_0000050]. Specific model of the sequencing instrument.
NGSSequencingPlatform.title: NGS Sequencing Platform

NGSUniqueBases.description: Count of unique basecalls present in the data.
NGSUniqueBases.title: NGS Unique Bases

SequencingRNALevel1Id.description: A unique identifier used by schematic for record updates and as a reference key in other schemas
SequencingRNALevel1Id.title: SequencingRNALevel1_id
